prompt: There are 3 nests on a tree. Each nest has 4 bird eggs. Which mathematical sentence shows the total number of eggs using repeated addition?
explanation: Since there are 3 groups (nests) and each group has 4 items (eggs), repeated addition adds the group size 3 times: 4 + 4 + 4 = 12 { eggs}

prompt: Liza has 1 whole round pizza. She cuts it into 2 equal parts and gives 1 part to her brother. What fraction of the pizza did her brother receive?
explanation: When 1 whole object is divided into 2 equal parts, each part represents one-half ($\frac{1}{2}$) of the whole.

prompt: Which image or description shows one-fourth (1/4) of a shape shaded?
optionA: A square divided into 2 equal parts with 1 part shaded
optionB: A square divided into 4 equal parts with 1 part shaded
optionC: A square divided into 4 equal parts with 2 parts shaded
optionD: A square divided into 3 equal parts with 1 part shaded
explanation: The fraction (1/4) means 1 shaded part out of a total of 4 equal parts.

prompt: A group has 8 mangoes. If Ben takes half 1/2 of the set, how many mangoes does Ben get?
explanation: Finding one-half (1/2) of a set means dividing the total set into 2 equal parts: 8 // 2 = 4 { mangoes}

prompt: Teacher Maya has 10 pencils. She wants to place them into groups of 2. How many equal groups can she make?
explanation: Counting by 2s up to 10 gives 5 groups (2, 4, 6, 8, 10). Dividing 10 into groups of 2 results in 5 equal groups (10 // 2 = 5).
